items.claim: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is now generally available for building and running AI agents at scale.
items.source_title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is now generally available
items.quote:
Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is now generally available.
AgentCore is an agentic platform to build, deploy and operate AI agents securely at scale, using any framework and any foundation model.

items.claim: Amazon Aurora DSQL is now generally available as a serverless distributed SQL database with active-active high availability.
items.source_title: Amazon Aurora DSQL is now generally available
items.quote: Amazon Aurora DSQL is now generally available. Aurora DSQL is a serverless, distributed SQL database with virtually unlimited scale, active-active high availability, PostgreSQL compatibility and no infrastructure to manage. Single-Region clusters offer 99.99% availability and multi-Region clusters offer 99.999% availability. Aurora DSQL is available in the following AWS Regions: US East (N. Virginia), US East (Ohio), US West (Oregon), Asia Pacific (Osaka), Asia Pacific (Tokyo), Europe (Ireland), Europe (London) and Europe (Paris).

items.claim: Amazon S3 Vectors is now GA and lets you store and query vector embeddings natively in S3 at massive scale.
items.reason: Check 3 failed: 'Launch stage is generally available (GA)' is not backed (The sentences say the service is in preview, not GA. The heading reads 'Amazon S3 Vectors (Preview)'); 'Stores and queries vector embeddings (the word 'embeddings' is not used)' is not backed (The sentences say 'vectors', not 'vector embeddings'); 'At massive scale' is not backed (The sentences give a limit of up to 10,000 vector indexes per vector bucket, and do not describe the service as operating at massive scale).
